captions.detailed: A 3D-printable figurine of a stylized cartoon character, resembling a minion, standing on a circular display base. The character features a capsule-shaped body, two circular goggle-clad eyes, a subtle mouth line, and thin arms, with one arm holding a large rocket prop that has a conical nose cone and a flared exhaust nozzle. The model stands at a slight forward-leaning angle, supported by two short cylindrical legs anchored to the base.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric cartoon character generator in OpenSCAD that resembles a capsule-shaped minion. The script should randomize or allow manual adjustment of features like height, radius, number of eyes, mouth expression, arm angles, and hand-held props, all mounted on a circular display base.
captions.factory: The model's body is constructed using a cylinder with hemispherical ends. Goggles and eyes are built using rotated and translated cylinders, while the mouth is subtracted from the body using boolean difference. The arms and legs are composed of rotated cylinders, and the hand-held rocket prop is assembled from a cylinder, a cone, and a flared cone nozzle, all positioned on a flat circular base cylinder.
